name: Cochabamba

queries.query: Cochabamba catastro municipal mapa digital parcelas predios código catastral oficial GIS
queries.scope: Follow the municipal digital cadastre map link and discover whether it exposes safe public full-vector geometry.
queries.result: The current Gobierno Autónomo Municipal de Cochabamba homepage advertises “Mapa digital de Cochabamba” and says residents can obtain a cadastral code through the map. Its public client script points to `http://mapadigital.cochabamba.bo/public/generado2`. That route returned an HTML form shell with a POST action and Google reCAPTCHA script; it exposed no parcel feature schema or geometry response. The Catastro Cbba site is presented as the municipal Geographic Administration and Cadastre directorate, but direct HTTPS access returned a Cloudflare 403 due to a locally prohibited DNS/IP target; this is not evidence that the origin is down.
queries.executionMethod: Spanish-language search, official municipal homepage and static client-script inspection, and anonymous GET of the linked map shell. No POST, captcha, cadastral-code or property-specific lookup was made.

requests.observation: Official municipal SPA shell; client-script inspection found the Digital Map link route.
Static client references `http://mapadigital.cochabamba.bo/public/generado2` as the digital cadastral map destination; no API/vector endpoint was exposed by this page script.
Returns a 1,452-byte HTML form with relative POST action `generado2` and a reCAPTCHA script; no parcel geometry or schema in response. Form not submitted.
Cloudflare “DNS points to prohibited IP” local policy response; not treated as provider downtime and not bypassed.
TLS connection refused before HTTP response; the municipal client itself links the HTTP URL. No TLS bypass or alternate endpoint guessing.

coverageAssessment: Municipal digital cadastral lookup is advertised. The map route returned only an HTML form shell, so no parcel geometry, WUP-point coverage, or vector layer was verified.
registryBasis: The official city homepage advertises its Digital Map specifically as a way to obtain a cadastral code, and the municipal Catastro site is identified as the Dirección de Administración Geográfica y Catastro. This confirms city-local cadastral services but does not verify public parcel geometries.
technicalBlocker: The linked map route exposes a form POST and reCAPTCHA, with no visible vector API or layer schema. The form was not submitted. HTTPS was refused and the city Catastro hostname received a local Cloudflare DNS/IP policy response; neither result is treated as proof of provider downtime.
remainingUncertainty: The user-facing map may render parcel outlines after its interactive form flow, but the public HTML/JS inspected did not document a safe anonymous vector endpoint or full geometry response. The WUP point has not been spatially tested.
nextStep: If the municipality publishes a documented non-captcha vector service, inspect it using a bounded safe-field query; do not submit the form or attempt captcha bypass.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
